description: Omaha, NE — Tonight, in the second of three debates between the candidates running to represent Nebraska’s Second Congressional District, frontrunner Denise Powell again made it clear that she is the only leader prepared to go to Washington to fight against Trump’s corruption and deliver for everyday working families in Nebraska.
